articles.title: UGC NET December 2026: NTA revises information bulletin, announces exam dates and key changes
articles.description: UGC NET December 2026: The National Testing Agency has revised the UGC NET December 2026 information bulletin through a corrigendum issued on October 16. The changes cover examination rules, evaluation, city preferences, footwear, gate closing times and payment gateway charges. The examination will take place on December 14, 15, 16, 17, 18 and 21.
